name: direct-3d-t1-hydrodynamics-transition
claim_boundary: Direct 3D event timing and topology for one isolated four-region curvilinear neighborhood with open local sheets and separate closed volume-support shells. The event-time predictor uses surface-tension traction measured on the current resolved 3D geometry with an overdamped frozen-traction local closure. This is not unrestricted arbitrary 3D T1, a resolved evolving liquid-border model, or singular liquid-border CFD.
